## Goal
Unblock taskqorg/dashq#255 A3: preserve all public limit and reset rows when TaskQ replaces ccusage. Live v4.6.74 rows omit Claude Fable and Antigravity Gemini windows.

## Acceptance
A1. Publish every observed Claude window, including seven_day_fable; the live public page reports Fable 2%, while TaskQ reports only seven_day 34%. Add regression protection for dropped model windows.
A2. Publish Antigravity Gemini 5h and weekly windows as well as 3p; the public page reports Gemini weekly 74%, while TaskQ publishes only 3p 0%. Retain unknown for missing or unsupported evidence.
A3. Record native producer evidence and regression checks here. Qualify released service heartbeat rows against ccusage in taskqorg/dashq#255 while ccusage still pushes: every card/window present, percentages within 5 points, resets within 600 s. Do not change logins or stop ccusage.

## Scope
- Account usage poll, capacity.md, heartbeat mapping and focused regression checks; taskqorg/dashq#255 contains the failing live comparison.

## Goal
Provide the Mac-only cause, minimal native correction and before/after frame, resize and CPU evidence needed to finish #2363.

## Acceptance
A1. Baseline Mac run records exact installed version/source, raw native resize events, frame/client/bottom positions and main/WebView CPU before correction; establish the cause or report reproduction as unknown.
A2. Using #2363 source 1b2371899d836213a0b4dce30196eb613b568333, prove a minimal ordinary-native-titlebar correction preserving body/background opacity, Close/dragging, manual sizing and themes; return its exact patch.
A3. Repeat the same bounded native rest/content/wrapping/titlebar sequence after correction; report event counts, bottom stability and CPU with raw logs and visuals; browser/static proof stays separate.
A4. Commit the qualification instrument, evidence and minimal correction patch as data; report exact source/patch hashes, remaining limits and native clipboard checks; do not publish the parent UI commits.

## Scope
- Different-host blocker under R2 and section 7 for #2363 / draft PR #2371. The parent keeps A1-A8 and final implementation/publication; accepted M3, M13 and Product scope is recorded there.
- Use the isolated Mac worktree and OS temp to test the frozen parent tree plus patch. Do not change the installed app, services, active sessions, grants or host policy.
- Do not bypass native/privacy denials or infer CPU causality from pictures or coalesced telemetry. Preserve existing appearance preferences outside the requested titlebar fix.
- Supply the patch and evidence to the parent continuation, with no independent product behavior change or live installation.

Rules: R6, R7, R8, R12, R13

## Goal
Claude workers can record slot-hold, spawn and first heartbeat telemetry with pid 0: launch returns only a job ID, the PID arrives at the first agents readback. On Mac #2374 attempt 6637484100 did so, failing the #2370 trace.

## Acceptance
A1. A Claude worker whose PID is not yet known at launch records slot-hold, spawn and every heartbeat with the real PID above 1, or records them only once it is known
A2. A lifecycle test with a delayed Claude PID readback fails before the fix and passes after; scripts/telemetry.sh keeps rejecting pid 0

## Scope
- src/service.rs
- src/runtime.rs
